Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Former homicide Squad senior detective Howard Groves, historian Ruth Goodman and consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes return one last time to re-investigate the legendary series of murders by the serial killer known as Jack the Ripper. This time it isn't murder but the delivery of a kidney, allegedly belonging to the last victim, that grabs the team's attention as they ascertain whether this was a crucial clue for police or merely an elaborate hoax.

programme.title: Patagonia
programme.desc: Along Patagonia's Pacific coast lies the fjordlands - beautiful, flooded valleys that were carved out by ice over millennia. During the summer, meltwater from glaciers pours into the fjords, stirring up nutrients and transforming these waters into one of the most nature-rich regions on Earth. They are home to a wealth of wildlife, including the largest animal that has ever lived - the blue whale - as well as the elusive, endemic Chilean dolphin.

programme.title: Tour Auvergne-rhone-alpes 2026
programme.desc: All the action from Stage 4 of the 2026 Tour Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes (formerly Criterium du Dauphine), as the peloton takes on a 165.8 km route starting in Le Puy and finishing in Montrond-les-Bains.

programme.title: Force Of Destiny
programme.desc: Robert is a renowned sculptor and is living alone when he is diagnosed with cancer. He meets Maya, an Indian marine biologist whose uncle also has cancer. Against all odds, Robert is put on the transplant list, creating hope for the future.

programme.title: Ben is Back
programme.desc: Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home on Christmas Eve. His mother, Holly is relieved but cautious about his recovery from addiction. Over 24 turbulent hours, Holly's love is tested as she fights to protect her son.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice

The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.desc: Along Patagonia's Pacific coast lies the fjordlands - beautiful, flooded valleys that were carved out by ice over millennia. During the summer, meltwater from glaciers pours into the fjords, stirring up nutrients and transforming these waters into one of the most nature-rich regions on Earth. They are home to a wealth of wildlife, including the largest animal that has ever lived - the blue whale - as well as the elusive, endemic Chilean dolphin.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Former homicide Squad senior detective Howard Groves, historian Ruth Goodman and consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes return one last time to re-investigate the legendary series of murders by the serial killer known as Jack the Ripper. This time it isn't murder but the delivery of a kidney, allegedly belonging to the last victim, that grabs the team's attention as they ascertain whether this was a crucial clue for police or merely an elaborate hoax.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig

Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Former homicide Squad senior detective Howard Groves, historian Ruth Goodman and consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes return one last time to re-investigate the legendary series of murders by the serial killer known as Jack the Ripper. This time it isn't murder but the delivery of a kidney, allegedly belonging to the last victim, that grabs the team's attention as they ascertain whether this was a crucial clue for police or merely an elaborate hoax.

One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig

programme.title: Finding Graceland

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

programme.desc: Robert is a renowned sculptor and is living alone when he is diagnosed with cancer. He meets Maya, an Indian marine biologist whose uncle also has cancer. Against all odds, Robert is put on the transplant list, creating hope for the future.

programme.title: Ben is Back
programme.desc: Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home on Christmas Eve. His mother, Holly is relieved but cautious about his recovery from addiction. Over 24 turbulent hours, Holly's love is tested as she fights to protect her son.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice

The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

programme.title: Force Of Destiny
programme.desc: Robert is a renowned sculptor and is living alone when he is diagnosed with cancer. He meets Maya, an Indian marine biologist whose uncle also has cancer. Against all odds, Robert is put on the transplant list, creating hope for the future.

programme.title: Ben is Back
programme.desc: Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home on Christmas Eve. His mother, Holly is relieved but cautious about his recovery from addiction. Over 24 turbulent hours, Holly's love is tested as she fights to protect her son.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

They are home to a wealth of wildlife, including the largest animal that has ever lived - the blue whale - as well as the elusive, endemic Chilean dolphin.

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig

Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.desc: Despite being close neighbours, these two large islands in the Mediterranean have distinctly different cheese traditions. While sampling Corsica’s renowned Brocciu, a soft ewe’s milk cheese, Will is introduced to a traditional version ripened with maggots. After a short ferry ride and a drive into the beautiful mountains of Sardinia, he meets a rock star shepherd and discovers an ancient curd cheese matured in a goat’s stomach, before exploring authentic Pecorino Fiore Sardo, an exceptional cheese hand-made by shepherds then smoked over an open fire.

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice

The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Former homicide Squad senior detective Howard Groves, historian Ruth Goodman and consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes return one last time to re-investigate the legendary series of murders by the serial killer known as Jack the Ripper. This time it isn't murder but the delivery of a kidney, allegedly belonging to the last victim, that grabs the team's attention as they ascertain whether this was a crucial clue for police or merely an elaborate hoax.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig

programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims

programme.desc: Ben Burns unexpectedly returns home on Christmas Eve. His mother, Holly is relieved but cautious about his recovery from addiction. Over 24 turbulent hours, Holly's love is tested as she fights to protect her son.

programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Moira Shearer stars as talented young dancer Victoria Page, cast in the leading role of the ballet, The Red Shoes. As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.

programme.title: The Seed Of The Sacred Fig
programme.desc: Family bonds unravel and generations clash in this extraordinary drama from acclaimed filmmaker Mohammad Rasoulof. Shot in secret and resulting in the persecution of its director, who was eventually forced to flee Iran, The Seed of the Sacred Fig combines gripping storytelling with real-life footage of recent protests in Iran, capturing a family's turmoil amid a society in upheaval.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: On a solo road trip to Memphis, Tennessee, widower Byron Gruman picks up a hitchhiker claiming to be the late Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. Directed by David Winkler and stars Harvey Keitel, Johnathon Schaech and Bridget Fonda.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A phenomenal cast of accomplished actresses help make famed director Franco Zeffirelli's semi-autobiographical tale an enchanting and warm film. A boy whose mother has died and whose father has all but abandoned him is raised by an eccentric, caustically witty group of older British and American women in 1930s Florence. Together, this group of expatriates act as the young boy's surrogate mothers, watching over him as they all weather the rise of fascism, the menacing political climate, and impending personal heartbreak.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople

A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Re-examining one of history's most infamous cold cases are three experts - consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, former murder detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman. Howard, Kerry, and Ruth analyse historical documents, contemporary press reports as well as police and witness statements hoping modern methods in policing, psychological profiling and historical context might unearth something that could have been missed at the time or since. Using our incident room and historical archive vault the team start with the discovery of the savagely mutilated body of 'Polly' Nichols in Whitechapel.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: The three experts, consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes, ex-Scotland Yard detective Howard Groves and social historian Ruth Goodman are back to continue re-examining the most infamous unsolved crime in British history. Beginning with the discovery of another body of a woman with her throat slashed in Whitechapel, the team explore the life of the victim Elizabeth Stride. Howard and Kerry then cast their expert eyes over the 1888 evidence, but when taking into account the smog and lack of lighting, they begin to question the reliability of witness statements.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper: Hidden Victims
programme.desc: Former homicide Squad senior detective Howard Groves, historian Ruth Goodman and consultant forensic psychologist Kerry Daynes return one last time to re-investigate the legendary series of murders by the serial killer known as Jack the Ripper. This time it isn't murder but the delivery of a kidney, allegedly belonging to the last victim, that grabs the team's attention as they ascertain whether this was a crucial clue for police or merely an elaborate hoax.

Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

As Victoria falls in love with up and coming composer Julian Craster (Marius Goring), she finds herself torn between simple human passion and the disciplined artistic devotion demanded by Boris Lermontov (Anton Walbrook), her jealous ballet company master. Like her character in the ballet, Victoria is in danger of dancing herself to death.
